City of Goodlettsville
      Sales and Use Tax Referendum
           Vote for One (1)

Shall the Goodlettsville Investment Act
(Ordinance No. 26-1146) for the purpose
of investing in vital City services such as
parks, roads, and public safety, by
increasing the City’s sales tax by a half-
penny per dollar, be approved?

   ◼ Against
